findings.title: Billing empty state is a bare string
findings.detail: No illustration, no explanation, no action.
findings.recommendation: Give it a cause, an expectation and a primary action.

findings.title: Profile fields carry no inline validation
findings.detail: Errors only appear after the round trip.
findings.recommendation: Validate on blur and name the fix in the message.

findings.title: Welcome offers no way back
findings.recommendation: Add a way to step back a screen.

findings.title: Embed copy repeats the product name three times
findings.detail: It reads as a template nobody edited.
